zip_caveats: ZIP 10463 is mostly Bronx (Kingsbridge, Riverdale) but also covers Marble Hill, which votes as part of Manhattan. ZIPs on the Westchester line (10466, 10470, 10471, 10475) are inside NYC, but neighboring Yonkers and Mount Vernon addresses are not. SD 34 and SD 36 extend into Westchester, and NY-16 is mostly Westchester. Within the Bronx, your ZIP does not decide your districts; your street address does. Your ballot will have ONE of these U.S. House races: NY-13, NY-14, NY-15, NY-16. ONE of these State Senate races: SD 11, 29, 31, 32, 33, 34, 36. ONE of these Assembly races: AD 77, 78, 79, 80, 81, 82, 83, 84, 85, 86, 87. Civil Court municipal-district races are on the ballot only in districts 1, 2 this year; if you live in another municipal court district you won't see one. Your exact ballot: enter your address at findmypollsite.vote.nyc. ZIP lists are standard USPS residential ZIPs for the borough, compiled for this guide, not an official Board of Elections crosswalk.
